summary: Your site loads slowly on phones and you're missing from Google's map results for the searches that matter most. The good news: the fixes are straightforward, and your 14 reviews at 4.6 stars are a solid base to build on.

fixes.title: Make the homepage load in under 2.5 seconds
fixes.detail: Compress the large photos and trim the WordPress plugins so the page shows in about 2 seconds on a phone instead of 5.2.

fixes.title: Get into the Google map results
fixes.detail: Fill in your Business Profile hours and ask recent customers for reviews, so you appear in the map for 'plumber richmond' where Pipe Pros sits now.

fixes.title: Renew the certificate and update WordPress
fixes.detail: Your security certificate runs out in 21 days and WordPress 6.2 is out of date; we'd update both and turn on automatic renewals.
